body:
Re-open - workaround
---

@Haroenv The issue is not about hiding. it is about combining disjunctive facets with excluded facets (.facetsExcludes). Please re-open, maybe someone will post a workaround.

I suspect some workaround is possible. The facetsExcludes is only needed when no disjunctive facet items are selected, when a disjunctive facet item is selected facetsExcludes is not required.

Hide facets item
---
This worked, but did not help. I was hoping it would solve another issue with "Show More".
"Show more" shows the items in the facetsExcludes, which I did not want. So I just got rid of the show more for now.

Instant Search v2
---
@pagealexandre  looking foward to IS2. Looks to fix several on my current issues.

I did try switching to IS2, is it possible?. It looks like a lot of work. Am not sure if it is even possible to switch but am keen to use it.
